entities.summary: Brian Kabir Robinson Jr., nicknamed "B Rob", is an American professional football running back for the Atlanta Falcons of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Alabama Crimson Tide, where he was a two-time national champion. Robinson was selected by the Washington Commanders in the third round of the 2022 NFL draft. Prior to his rookie season, he was shot twice during an armed robbery and returned to the team two months later.
